requirements.evidence: All contract routes present with correct names/middleware (routes/web.php:980-997: guest group, throttle:6,1 on password.email, signed verification.verify, auth+verified home). Login validates email:strict, rate-limits on Str::transliterate(Str::lower(email).'|'.ip) with 5 tries and auth.throttle on email, regenerates session and redirect()->intended(route('home')) (app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:52-94). Register uses key Str::transliterate('register|'.ip), Password::defaults(), confirmed, unique, fires Registered, logs in, regenerates (Register.php:333-364). Password::defaults configured once (AppServiceProvider.php:411). Reset rotates remember_token and fires PasswordReset (NewPasswordController.php:176-181); forgot always flashes passwords.sent (PasswordResetLinkController.php:220-222). User implements MustVerifyEmail; EmailVerificationRequest gives 403 on tampered id; resend returns home for verified users. .env.example and phpunit.xml locale pins done; ui.php in both locales with 'Entrar'/'Senha'/'Esqueceu a senha?'. Existing views converted to route()/__(). Gap: the requirement that the test suite verify these behaviours (e.g. 'with locale en shows Log in and no Portuguese', 7th request 429) is unverifiable because no tests ship; verify-email notice reuses verify_description as the 'link sent' message instead of a distinct confirmation (verify-email.blade.php:651).

conventions.evidence: Conventions mandate test-first and 'everything implemented ships with a test' — the diff contains no test files. Livewire components must validate with #[Validate] + $this->validate(); Login.php:254-257 and Register.php:345-349 pass inline rule arrays to validate() and have no #[Validate] attributes. Docs sync: only CHANGELOG.md updated (line 29); README/docs not touched despite new auth setup. Positives: Bulma markup, route() everywhere, $fillable already set on User, plain wire:model, internal helpers protected (Login.php:276,291).

security.evidence: Rate limiting on login (per email+IP) and register (per IP); session regenerate on login/register, invalidate+regenerateToken on logout (LogoutController.php:130-134); forgot-password does not reveal existence; remember_token rotated on reset; EmailVerificationRequest enforces id/hash match; all output escaped with {{ }}; passwords hashed. Minor: layouts/app.blade.php:752 loads Bulma from a third-party CDN without Subresource Integrity as a fallback; Livewire public properties carry no #[Validate] attributes (validated inline, so limited impact).

tests.evidence: No test files in change.diff at all — no feature tests for login, register, rate limiting, logout, password reset, verification tamper (403), localization, or Livewire unauthorized/tamper tests, despite conventions requiring them and the task describing test-suite expectations.

simplicity.evidence: Lean controllers reusing framework primitives (Password::sendResetLink, Password::reset, EmailVerificationRequest::fulfill, Auth::attempt). Home route is a closure (routes/web.php:991). Small redundancy: VerifyEmailController.php:103-109 both branches redirect to home; layout adds an unrequested Vite/CDN switch (layouts/app.blade.php:749-753).

readability.evidence: Small focused classes with clear names, consistent Bulma field markup across views. Nits: layouts/app.blade.php:779-783 opens with @isset but closes with @endif; EmailVerificationNoticeController uses request() helper while sibling controllers inject Request; register/login form markup is duplicated rather than extracted to Blade components.

scope.evidence: Nearly everything serves the task. Unrequested: APP_FAKER_LOCALE changed to pt_BR (.env.example:17); CDN Bulma fallback in the layout (layouts/app.blade.php:752); content rewrite of bulma-test/welcome pages beyond translating text (e.g. 'Primary Button' replaced by login link, welcome.blade.php:944-945).

issues.explanation: The change ships no Pest/PHPUnit tests for any of the new auth flows, violating the project's mandatory test-first rule and leaving rate limiting, verification tamper, reset and localization untested.
Livewire components validate with inline rule arrays instead of the project's mandated #[Validate] attributes on public properties.
Fallback loads Bulma from jsdelivr CDN without an integrity hash, an unrequested third-party dependency.
After resending, the success notification repeats the generic verify_description text instead of confirming a new link was sent.
Only the changelog was updated; README/docs were not checked or updated for the new auth setup.
APP_FAKER_LOCALE was changed to pt_BR, which the task did not ask for.
@isset is closed with @endif instead of @endisset (works but inconsistent).
Both branches redirect to home; the early return could be simplified.

review.summary: The change implements the full session auth flow (Livewire login/register with rate limiting, logout, password reset with remember_token rotation, e-mail verification, pt-BR/en ui translations, locale pins) and is functionally solid and reasonably secure. However, it ships no tests at all, which the project's TDD conventions treat as non-negotiable, and the Livewire components skip the mandated #[Validate] pattern, so it needs substantial rework before approval.
